defuss-shadcn / Multimedia / audio

Built with: CSS JS

AudioMOL

An audio player the page can drive. The native <audio> plays it; the component makes its playback a named state - default (paused) or playing, with the time, rate, volume, muted and captions as its config - in one row of Buttons, Sliders and readouts, binds controls anywhere on the page and shows the active caption as a transcript line. It runs on the same media engine as Video, and a Media Timeline drives it the same way.

Native basis

<div class="audio" role="group"> holding a native <audio> without controls, the play toggle, a .audio-body (title, .audio-progress scrubber, optional .audio-captions line) and the sound controls.

Web Platform APIs

<audio>HTMLMediaElementTextTrackaria-pressed@container

Classes

.audio.audio-body.audio-title.audio-progress.audio-time.audio-captions.audio-volume.audio-volume-panel.audio-tracks

Data attributes

• data-audio-action - toggle, play, pause, skip (+ data-value seconds), seek (a range), mute, volume (a range), rate (a select, or a button with data-value), captions

• data-audio-output - time, duration, remaining

• data-audio-for="id" - a control (or a container of controls) outside the player drives the player with that id

• <script type="application/json" class="audio-tracks"> - the player's own text tracks by key; two or more turn a captions button into a Dropdown Menu

• .audio-volume - the sound button with a vertical volume in a .audio-volume-panel above it (data-side="bottom": below)

data-variant="compact" - no frame and no title

§Audio

One row: play, the title over the scrubber and its readouts, sound and volume. Open the State tab - playing, time, rate, volume, muted and captions are the player's state.

×%Studio

§Compact

data-variant='compact' drops the frame and the title - the controls alone, for a row in a list or a line of text. The sound button carries the volume as a vertical slider (.audio-volume): its panel opens below the row (data-side='bottom') while the pointer or the focus is on it, so the row stays one line.

×%Studio

§Rate and skip

A select of rates and two skip buttons inside the row - the select shows the rate that plays, whoever set it.

×%Studio

§Controls anywhere on the page

A row outside the player names it once with data-audio-for: its toggle and its readout drive and follow the player. The three buttons call df$.shadcn.audio - each jumps to a sound of the recording and plays from there.

×%Studio

§The API and the store

df$.shadcn.audio plays, pauses, seeks and mutes by name; el.store reports every change - the line under the buttons is written by a store subscriber.

×%Studio

§States

Named states via the shared State API, bound on each .audio:

  • default - paused: at the start, wherever it was paused, or at the end
  • playing - playing; a browser may refuse to start sound without a click on the page (autoplay rules), and the state then stays default

Both take the same config, merged into the current one - only the keys passed change something: time (seek), rate, volume, muted, captions (the key of the text track shown, "" for none). getState() reports them live, with the duration.

The first example carries data-state-demo; bun run screenshots drives it via el.api.setState(name) and captures screenshots/{mode}/audio-{state}.png.

Machine contract - verified against audio.schema.json by bun run verify:

StateTypeValuesDefaultDescription
playingbooleantrue, falsefalseThe audio plays (setState('playing')); unchecked it pauses.
timenumber—0The playback position in seconds - setState(current, { time }) seeks; observed from getState().config.time.
ratenumber—1The playback rate - 1 is normal speed.
volumenumber—1The volume, 0 to 1.
mutedbooleantrue, falsefalseThe sound is off.
captionsstring—""The key of the text track the transcript line shows (a track's id, a <track>'s id or srclang), empty for none - true and false are accepted.

§CSS view file

The row, the body and its scrubber, the transcript line, the icon swap of the toggles and the compact variant.

/* -- Audio component ------------------------------------------ */
/* A native <audio> (no controls of its own) behind one row: the  */
/* play toggle, a title over the scrubber and its readouts, the   */
/* sound controls - Buttons, Sliders and readouts                 */
/* (data-audio-action / -output). An optional line under the      */
/* scrubber shows the active caption cue, a transcript as it is   */
/* spoken. data-variant="compact" drops the frame and the title.  */
@layer components {
  .audio {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    inline-size: 100%;
    min-inline-size: 0;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background-color: var(--card);
    color: var(--card-foreground);
    container-type: inline-size;
    & > audio:not([controls]) {
      display: none;
    }
    & > [data-audio-action="volume"] {
      inline-size: 4.5rem;
    }
  }
  .audio-body {
    display: grid;
    flex: 1;
    gap: 0.125rem;
    min-inline-size: 0;
  }
  .audio-title {
    overflow: hidden;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .audio-progress {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    min-inline-size: 0;
    & > [data-audio-action="seek"] {
      flex: 1;
      min-inline-size: 3rem;
    }
  }
  /* a readout: m:ss in even digits, so the row does not jitter */
  .audio-time {
    min-inline-size: 2.5rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    text-align: center;
  }
  /* the active cue - collapses when captions are off or nothing is said */
  .audio-captions {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-style: italic;
    text-wrap: pretty;
    &:empty {
      display: none;
    }
  }
  /* a toggle with two icons shows the first when off, the second when on (play / pause, sound / muted) */
  [data-audio-action][aria-pressed="false"] > :nth-child(2),
  [data-audio-action][aria-pressed="true"] > :nth-child(1):not(:only-child) {
    display: none;
  }
  /* a control the page may not use (full screen in a frame without it) - over the Button's own display */
  [data-audio-action][hidden] {
    display: none;
  }
  /* a rate select keeps its own width in the row (a Select is as wide as its box) */
  select[data-audio-action="rate"] {
    flex: none;
    inline-size: auto;
  }
  /* the sound button with a vertical volume in a panel above it (below with data-side="bottom"), shown while the
     pointer or the focus is on either - the row keeps one button's width */
  .audio-volume {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
  }
  .audio-volume-panel {
    position: absolute;
    inset-block-end: 100%;
    inset-inline-start: 50%;
    z-index: 3;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    margin-block-end: 0.375rem;
    padding: 0.75rem 0.625rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background-color: var(--popover);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    translate: -50% 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    opacity: 0;
    /* the gap to the button belongs to the hover */
    &::after {
      position: absolute;
      inset-inline: 0;
      inset-block-start: 100%;
      block-size: 0.5rem;
      content: "";
    }
    /* a vertical range's block axis is horizontal: its length is its height */
    & > .slider[data-orientation="vertical"] {
      height: 5.5rem;
    }
    .audio-volume:is(:hover, :focus-within) > & {
      visibility: visible;
      opacity: 1;
    }
    .audio-volume[data-side="bottom"] > & {
      inset-block: 100% auto;
      margin-block: 0.375rem 0;
      &::after {
        inset-block: auto 100%;
      }
    }
  }
  .audio[data-variant="compact"] {
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    background-color: transparent;
    & .audio-title {
      display: none;
    }
  }
  /* a narrow player keeps play, the scrubber, the time and the sound */
  @container (inline-size < 22rem) {
    .audio > [data-audio-action="volume"],
    .audio > [data-audio-action="rate"],
    .audio-progress > [data-audio-output="duration"] {
      display: none;
    }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
    .audio-volume-panel {
      transition:
        opacity 0.15s ease,
        visibility 0.15s allow-discrete;
    }
  }
  @media (prefers-contrast: more) {
    .audio-time,
    .audio-captions {
      color: var(--foreground);
    }
  }
  @media (forced-colors: active) {
    .audio,
    .audio-volume-panel {
      border-color: CanvasText;
    }
    .audio-volume-panel {
      background-color: Canvas;
    }
  }
}

§JavaScript view file

The states, the API and the init - the media engine itself is shared with Video in core: src/shared/media.ts.

// -- Audio ---------------------------------------------------
// A stateful audio player over the native <audio>: the states default (paused) and playing, the playback position,
// rate, volume, muted and captions as the state's config, controls inside the player or anywhere on the page
// (data-audio-for), the active caption cue as a transcript line and an imperative API (df$.shadcn.audio). The media
// engine - reading the element, applying a config, the controls, the captions - is shared with the Video component
// (src/shared/media.ts, emitted once in core); this file keeps the states, the API and the init.
// Shared preamble (AGENTS.md "State API"); the implementation lives in core.js —
// build.ts rewrites this import into a df$.shadcn.shared binding in dist/.
import {
  defussGlobals,
  defussQuery,
  componentState,
  bindComponent,
  bindMedia,
  mediaApply,
  mediaMarkup,
  mediaRead,
  mediaTracks,
} from '../../../shared/state-api.js';
const df$ = defussGlobals();
const dfDollar = defussQuery();
const audioStates = ['default', 'playing'];
/** The config both states take - every key optional; only the keys passed are applied. */
export interface AudioConfig {
  /** the playback position to seek to, seconds; getState() reports the live position */
  time?: number;
  /** the playback rate - 1 is normal speed, 2 twice as fast */
  rate?: number;
  /** the volume, 0 to 1 */
  volume?: number;
  /** the sound is off */
  muted?: boolean;
  /** the key of the text track to show (its id, a <track>'s id or srclang - see the captions menu), '' for none;
   *  true shows the current or first one, false none. getState() reports the key shown */
  captions?: string | boolean;
  /** the audio's length, seconds - reported by getState() (0 until the metadata loaded), never set */
  duration?: number;
}
/** One cue of a text track. */
export interface AudioCue {
  /** where it starts, seconds */
  start?: number;
  /** where it ends, seconds */
  end?: number;
  /** the words */
  text?: string;
}
